development: new verification modules (\texttt{vN}), status changes, editorial passes and
infrastructure. It is maintained \emph{in the same change} as the work it records, and it is
also imported at the end of the \texttt{introduction} document. Module numbers \texttt{vN}
refer to \texttt{verification/vN\_*.py}; claim IDs refer to rows of
\texttt{verification/status\_ledger.csv}.

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-08-03 (LII) (the third daily bundling: FIFTEEN promotions (\texttt{v701}--\texttt{v715}, $158$ new checks, all green) --- the T-B census reaches $69/70$, the Z1 continuum candidate is ASSEMBLED, and the moonshot's atom layer is groupoid-internal. HIGHLIGHT 3 (the chain arc S-A--S-G, \texttt{v702}--\texttt{v711}): the lookahead question DECIDED (\texttt{v702}, $13/13$, \textsc{flow-verifier-not-generator}: full comb verified $913\ge898$, autonomous reach $2$--$4$ slots, $g\sim5$--$12$ bits/slot information-theoretic); tolerance induction DEAD at RH grade (\texttt{v703}, $10/10$); G1 open as a closed form (\texttt{v704}, $5/5$: best law C2 median $0.9947$, max $0.3130$); the arch IS a deck-sector trace (\texttt{v705}, $7/7$: exact tower traces $3.4\times10^{-16}$, scalar forced $1$, must-fail $\times82$ --- the geometry anchor); WEYL-NULL with the Schur-parameter identity ($10^{-40}$) and the $\log 2$ find (\texttt{v706}, $10/10$); the section edge is an exact resolvent identity ($3\times10^{-13}$) with the corridor position $\sim0.53$ open (\texttt{v707}, $9/9$); the best position functional transports scalar-free (Levinson energy extremum, median $0.9986$; outliers exactly on $16/64/81$; \texttt{v708}, $7/7$); the residual carries NO zero signature behind a temporal SHA256 firewall (\texttt{v709}, $10/10$, \textsc{layering-rejected}); the two-stage law dies by its own bar but its Hecke stage heals the prime powers $11.7\%\to0.53\%$ circle-free from E8 counting (\texttt{v710}, $7/7$); the first-birth error CONVERGES (promotion run $\theta=1.851$, $R^2=0.692$, bars $0.5/0.6$; \texttt{v711}, $7/7$) --- net: $G1=[\mathrm{E}$-edge$]+[\mathrm{E}$-Hecke$]+[\mathrm{M}$-rate$]$.  THE REST: the keystone identity (\texttt{v701}, $11/11$: $B=$ sine-moment form$(c+\mathrm{pole})$ $+$ rank-1 pole square exact; the three gaps collapse onto ONE; triplication $\mu_3$-unique; V5 numerology dead) and the QGEO CAR route (\texttt{v715}, $22/22$, \textsc{qgeo-car-rates-summable}: all $6{+}1$ channels Schatten-Cauchy with summable rates, FH renormalization lattice-derived via Barnes~$G$ at $8.8\times10^{-7}$, RP cone stable; the majorant lemma (L1)--(L3) named --- \texttt{GATE.QGEO} does not move). \subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (XX) (prime-front diary T175 (the placement phases are real and causal but non-smooth, the heterogeneity dissolves into the error bar, and the densest reachable bin is consistent with zero --- PHASES-RESIST) + paper + website sync; NO promotion, NO marker moves)}

an $\alpha$-regression in disguise); only the cell phase
$\varphi_p(h)=\mathrm{frac}(h\theta_p)$ is free and equidistributed (largest $Z=1.41$
on $1316$ cells), with the generating identity

$1.1\times10^{-13}$ (Weyl 1916). \emph{The phases are real in $\log R$}: $F=10.80$
against a within-rung-scrambled null with $95\%$ point $1.69$, $+10.3\%$ held-out
residual variance under a rank-parity split, a composite placebo family at
$F=0.81/-0.0275$, amplitudes monotone in $p$ ($0.018$ at $p=5$ to $0.141$ at $p=19$).

worsen held out). \emph{What resolves the heterogeneity is the error bar}: with
jackknife slope errors the excess scatter goes $0.1224\to0.0000$ and the robust pull
spread $1.41\to1.22$ (model-free interleaved half-split $0.2722$ against
$\mathrm{sd}=0.2789$) --- T174's $\chi^2$ was substantially an OLS independence
assumption, not a physical spread; \emph{the $5\sigma$ deficit is unaffected} (its bar
never came from $\mathrm{se}_n$). \emph{(2) The dense limit.} The corner is exhausted

falls $+0.982\pm0.213\to+0.576\to+0.207\to+0.194\to+0.088\to-0.057\pm0.132$ ---
monotone within $2\sigma$ at every step, density slope $6.1\sigma$, \emph{the densest

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-29 (VIII) (\texttt{v553} --- the exact-form identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T159 (the gauge identity and the Z-matrix law, cancellation is the weight, FORM-RESISTS) + paper + website sync; NO marker moves)}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=1.5em]

identities and certified inequalities with the direction in the name --- no fit, no
$D$-exponent, no zone-uniform statement, and explicitly \emph{no statement for all $D$}

direction \emph{executed}, not asserted: $8$ random trial vectors per window never exceed

direction itself is the check). The ladder $g_K=\sum_{j\le K}y_j^2$, $y=L^{-1}e_1$ from
\emph{one} Cholesky of the leading $16\times16$ block: all terms strictly positive,
partial sums strictly monotone, $1/s\le1/g_{16}\le1/g_1=B_{11}$ literally on $12/12$,
tight to $1.0642$--$1.1522$ against the declared cap $1.5$ (T158 measured $\le1.2738$ at
$h=254\ldots1393$, sandbox); mutation: a $5\%$ corruption of one off-diagonal entry
destroys positive definiteness --- the Cholesky \emph{refuses} on $12/12$.
\item \textbf{(2) The two-dimensionality (T158, P2) \mE.}
$\mathrm{span}\{t_1,A^{-1}L_Pt_1\}$ attains $s$ exactly ($g/s=1$ to $9.0\times10^{-13}$ on
$12/12$) for the theorem reason $L_Pt_1=\mu^P_1t_1$ (KMS 1953, eigenpair residual

reflection-odd section $A_{rs}=c_{|r-s|}-c_{M-1-r-s}$ annihilates constant lag vectors
\emph{entrywise with zero tolerance} ($\mathrm{odd\_toeplitz}(\mathbf 1)=0$ exactly ---
the mechanism in one line), hence the gauge identity $\sum_dw_d=0$ holds to

\item \textbf{(1) The union identity for nested cakes (T146) \mE.} For a nested decreasing chain

$\sum_{j,l}c_jc_l\,|S_j\cup S_l|=2T\|\psi_t\|_1-\|\psi_t\|^2$ with $T=\sum_jc_j$ and

movable at all; exact ($0.0$) against T145's $K\times K$ double sum on all $12$ window minimisers
and $9$ random vectors, \emph{and} against the union sizes computed from the sets themselves with
no nestedness used (controls: one shuffled proper level set $3.2\times10^{-2}$, a $1\%$
perturbation of the heaviest coefficient $4.8\times10^{-3}$).

$G(b)\le2b^2\,\|v\|_\infty\|v\|_1/\|v\|^2+\varepsilon(b)$ for \emph{any} vector at all $6$
preregistered bases (margin $\ge1.08$ on the battery and on every window minimiser); at $b=2$ the
leading constant is the classical dyadic $8$ \emph{exactly}, and the base is \emph{free} because
the chain consumes only the lower domination $|v|\le\psi_t$ --- the a-priori constant gains

draw and base, and the one-level-down cake breaks the domination on every draw --- the $+1$ in the

$c_0^{\mathrm{ap}}=2b^2\,\Gamma\min(1,\Gamma_1)+\varepsilon=3.9042$--$4.8488$ dominates the

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-28 (III) (\texttt{v545} --- the Hardy-core identities of phase 2 promoted; prime-front diary T140/T141 + website sync; NO marker moves)}

\subsection*{\interlinepenalty=150\relax 2026-07-28 (II) (\texttt{v543} + \texttt{v544} --- the lumped $M$-matrix pair and the long-lag support structure promoted; prime-front diary T136/T137 + website sync; NO marker moves)}

\item \textbf{New module \texttt{v543} (\texttt{PRIME.MMATRIX.IDENT.01}).} Promotion of the
identity/theorem block of the discovery part T136 ($35$ checks, ${\sim}1$\,s), recomputed on small

theorems with \emph{checked} hypotheses, and one \emph{negative} per-instance result; no fit, no
$D$-exponent, no uniform-in-zone claim, no floor value. Battery: $20$ seam windows

\item \textbf{(1)--(2) The lumped pair and the congruence \mE.} With $\Delta$ the positive
off-diagonal part and $L_\Delta=\mathrm{diag}(\Delta\mathbf 1)-\Delta$, the pair

($4.4\times10^{-15}$), and the \emph{declared circularity} $\lambda_{\max}(W)<1\iff A\succ0$ is
checked in \emph{both} directions ($0$ exceptions forward; $39/39$ shifted controls in the
indefinite range give $\lambda_{\max}(W)\ge1$) --- the Loewner sandwich is vacuous by itself, and
that is the content.
\item \textbf{(3)--(4) The anchor and the empty shift ladder \mE.} With $x=A_B^{-1}\mathbf 1\ge0$
and $A_B^{-1}\ge0$ entrywise (Ostrowski 1937, \emph{checked}),
$\lambda_{\min}(A_B)\ge1/\max_r x_r$ on all $39$ rows (min slack $3.0\times10^{-3}$, sharpest ratio
$0.9070$) --- one solve, one sign check, no eigenvalue (control: a positive off-diagonal makes it
false, $1.9000>0.1000$). Lumping commutes with diagonal shifts, $(A-sI)_B=A_B-sI$
($2.5\times10^{-16}$ on $312$ rungs), and $(A_B-sI)^{-1}\ge A_B^{-1}\ge0$ entrywise
(Berman--Plemmons 1979, violation $0$), so $\max_r x_r(s)$ and the a-priori margin
$\|L_\Delta\|_\infty\max_r x_r(s)$ are non-decreasing along the whole ladder: the shifted ladder is
\emph{structurally empty} --- a theorem, not a measurement.

($1.1\times10^{-1}$); at a sign-changing test vector the quotient bound is false on $39/39$.

  dimensionless ratio $m/\mu=e^{3/4}$, and in $d{=}2$ that ratio \emph{is} the induced
  Newton constant $1/G$ (\vref{v68}). So $v_{\mathrm{geo}}$ (\vref{v78}), $1/G$
  (\vref{v68}) and $m/\mu$ are \emph{one} dimensionful anchor in three readings --- the
  irreducibles stay $\{$one scale, $\pi\}$, and \texttt{SEAM.THEOREM.01}'s residual
  reduces to the kernel-identification premise alone. \emph{Audit (not promoted):} the
  log-ratio is numerically $\tfrac34=q(A_3)$, the target value the anchor takes in seam
  units --- not a derivation (ledger \texttt{SEAM.EHMODEL.03}).
